content: Rnd2 is a small signaling G protein, specifically a GTPase, with an approximate molecular weight of 21 kDa. It belongs to the Rnd subgroup within the Rho family of GTPases. The protein is encoded by the RND2 gene. This particular member of the Rho family has been implicated in the regulation of neuronal morphology and endosomal trafficking. The RND2 gene is located on chromosome 17 and is positioned as the centromeric neighbor of the BRCA1 gene, which is associated with breast and ovarian cancer susceptibility. Rnd2 has been demonstrated to interact with the following proteins: ARHGAP5, RACGAP1, and UBXD5.
